1879060180.name: Guardian's Threat
1879060180.desc: This stance focuses on enraging your enemies.

1879064148.name: Last Stand
1879064148.desc: You are able to resist succumbing to defeat for a short time.

1879073364.name: Eldarin Arrow
1879073364.desc: Through your knowledge of Elvish or dwarf-virtues, your arrow causes light damage over time.

1879089876.name: Strength of the Earth
1879089876.desc: Steady yourself and shut out the world around you, reducing Incoming Damage while restoring Morale, Power, and Focus.

1879138644.name: Blight
1879138644.desc: You cover the area in a foul slime that reduces the effectiveness of healing.

1879193556.name: Muster in Sûri-kylä
1879193556.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Sûri-kylä in Forochel.

1879213908.name: Twisting the Dagger (Melee)
1879213908.desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879218260.name: Improved Focus
1879218260.desc: Before combat, rapidly increase your Focus as well as your damage and Crit chance.\n\nFocus is required to use some bow skills and is lost if you move.

1879238484.name: Guide to Caras Galadhon
1879238484.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Caras Galadhon in Lothlorien.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879243988.name: Rally the Riders
1879243988.desc: You issue a fearsome call to arms that negatively affects enemies surrounding you while bolstering allies around you.

1879244244.name: All in the Wrist
1879244244.desc: Your skill allows you to sometimes accomplish truly remarkable feats on the field of battle; while many are in awe of what you do - it is all in the wrist.

1879255508.name: Inspirational Verse
1879255508.desc: You focus your energies and etchings toward supporting you and your allies finding inspiration in the verses.

1879255892.name: Launch a Blue Firework
1879255892.desc: Launches a bright blue firework for the Bree festival show.

1879287380.name: First Aid
1879287380.desc: Some basic curative knowledge allows you to remove a single poison, disease, wound, or fear from yourself.

1879302612.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Pilgrim)
1879302612.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879316052.name: Bee Swarm
1879316052.desc: Unleashes bees on the target, dealing damage over time. Places a physical mitigation debuff on the target.

1879329364.name: Brown Snake
1879329364.desc: Summons a snake to keep you company.

1879334740.name: Dúnadan's Strike
1879334740.desc: Aragorn is the master of both blade and bow. This attack will stun the opponent.

1879335508.name: Loyal Swan-knight
1879335508.desc: Summons a Swan-knight of Dol Amroth to keep you company.

1879339348.name: Black-wing Kite
1879339348.desc: Brings out a black-wing kite for you to fly!

1879360852.name: Striped Snake
1879360852.desc: Brings out a striped snake to keep you company.

1879391444.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Elvish Huntress)
1879391444.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879401044.name: Hunting Steed
1879401044.desc: A steed with minimal trappings, perfect for navigating dense forests and jumping obstacles.

1879453012.name: Inspire Fellows
1879453012.desc: Heals the Morale of the Fellowship.\n\nThis skill is not usable in Dissonance.

1879486036.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Hobbit-lad Bounder)
1879486036.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879492180.name: Marching Orders
1879492180.desc: Command your war-band to move offensively, twisting the corruption in their flesh into a knife for the glory of Angmar.

1879494100.name: Guise of Servant of the First Crafter
1879494100.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of the Servant of the First Crafter as he appeared in his true form. Perfect for crafting in style!

1879495252.name: Memory of Triumph
1879495252.desc: A Memory of Triumph can be used to inspire an ally to greater feats on the battle-field.

1879497684.name: Sign of the Wild: Protection
1879497684.desc: Command your pet to use a defensive ability, prioritizing survival above all else.

1879502164.name: Hedgehog and Hare Parade
1879502164.desc: Summons a cheerful hedgehog pulling his friend the hare in a cart.

1879506644.name: Wisp of Frost
1879506644.desc: Gelid Wind adherents deal frost damage swiftly. <rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Frost Wisp, Spike, and Breath gain the ability to tier up the Chilled Bones effect if present, up to Tier 3.

1879508564.name: Pony of Umbar
1879508564.desc: Summons a desert pony of Umbar to accompany you on your travels.

1879528276.name: Prepared: Wisp of Acid
1879528276.desc: The wicked have learned to recover magical sustenance from the infliction of pain.

conditionalEffects.description: Acid Wisp, Spike, and Breath gain the ability to tier up the Pitted Armaments effect if present, up to Tier 3.
